description.public:
Nobody admits to brewing it and nobody asks where it comes from. A swig of this murky violet tonic and the voices quiet down, the shadows stop moving, and for a while it really will be alright.

The mind remembers the relief, though. Each dose leaves you a little more Addicted, and an addicted mind needs a stronger dose to feel anything at all.

actions.name: Take a Dose
actions.description:
Take the @ref[item.name] straight after a Rest, or give it to an adjacent ally. An @Condition[insane] hero cannot Rest, but may take a dose at any time out of combat, and it is the one thing that brings them back. A dose that ends Insanity leaves them in a Fragile Calm: their next Rest restores no Madness. The target recovers @Rule[resource.madness]{Madness} by the quality of the dose, less a penalty for how Addicted they already are. Then the dose adds to their addiction.

  • Shoddy - Recover 1 Madness. Addiction +1.

  • Standard - Recover 5 Madness. Addiction +2.

  • Fine - Recover 10 Madness. Addiction +3.

  • Superior - Recover 20 Madness. Addiction +4.

  • Masterwork - Recover 40 Madness. Addiction +5.

Tolerance. Each level of addiction weakens a dose by more than the last: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36 Madness at levels 1 to 8.

Getting clean. A Rest lowers addiction by 1, but only if you took no dose since your last Rest.
